liveChecks: Visited all 48 topic/target combinations across OCD DBS, depression DBS, depression TMS, OCD TMS and All evidence. Checked titles, finding counts, study choices, legend entries and control availability. Retested OCD DBS after initial loading completed.

Confirmed complete tract names and expanded cortical-region names; no repeated atlas or gray-matter-reference suffixes in the legend. Legend is outside the canvas and document has no horizontal overflow at 1280 by 720.
Enabled VLPFC and OFC together: both colors and the overlap key appear. Zero regional opacity removes those keys. A functional map pauses region colors with an explicit restore instruction.

Selected Taylor as a comparison in DLPFC, then selected Fox R2-01-1: the unrelated map cleared. Study-coordinate toggles remained available after turning points off and their legend keys tracked actual visibility.
Searched for an unmatched string: the specific search message and Clear search button appeared; clearing restored 16 DLPFC findings. Filtering Fox retained DLPFC and returned two findings.
Hovered the anterior corticostriatal tract: complete name, anchored light callout and source names appeared. The hovered tract was 0.95 opacity and the other tract 0.425. Escape cleared the callout.

Medial view selected the left hemisphere. Switching to SCC restored its usual view and legend; selecting Holtzheimer changed the caption to finding-specific anatomy without incorrectly claiming a pink cortical highlight.
Confirmed continuous Siddiqi map color key and reset behavior. Verified all 18 configured local PDF files exist; original PDFs and the private source manifest were not modified.
No captured browser warnings or errors. Screenshot saved as docs/ui-qa.png.
validationScope: Terminology and interface QA; 29 automated regression groups, JavaScript syntax, all 48 topic/target combinations, focused live interaction checks and visual inspection at the natural 1280 by 720 browser size. No new clinical literature reanalysis or anatomical registration was performed.
remainingLimits: AAL3 native-affine surfaces are approximate against the existing MNI2009c cortex; inter-template nonlinear registration was not performed or validated.

dmPFC is a broad non-orbital medial superior-frontal proxy; pre-SMA is anterior AAL SMA without the Ji patient-specific superficial restriction or connectivity target. Other named regions remain gross-anatomical parcel unions.
Study-specific targets, patient electrodes, electric fields, tractograms and exact treatment masks remain unavailable.
Uncertain right bitemporofrontal/bifrontal name remains unresolved. VLPFC mechanistic evidence is not clinical efficacy evidence.
The existing 11 population tract files are unchanged; preset families are not endpoint-filtered to the stimulation target. Bilateral reference tracts do not imply bilateral treatment.

Hyperdirect pre-SMA–STN, exact Jimenez ALIC–OFC, right-insula–left-DLPFC and complete indirect DLPFC–sgACC route geometry is unavailable in this build. C_FP shows only the frontoparietal cingulum segment.

Seguin 2026 was reviewed at abstract/data-availability level; route geometry and full subscription text were not reproduced. Functional and healthy-volunteer mechanistic findings do not establish clinical tract-specific efficacy.
Hover describes population reference anatomy or original point metadata; it does not infer patient-specific activation. Touch input retains tap/rotate behavior rather than persistent desktop hover.
Saved links preserve camera presets, not the exact rotation of a freely dragged view.
This pass verified the current desktop layout; phone-size, touch and assistive-technology audits were not performed.
